title: slugify mishandles empty strings in custom charmaps
prompt: slugify.extend() lets you map a character to an empty string to delete it, but in slugify.js such a mapping is ignored and the original character leaks through (the lookup treats the empty string as 'not found'). After slugify.extend({'ъ': ''}), slugify('ъяъ') should return 'ya', and slugify('ъяъ', { remove: /[]/g }) should also return 'ya'. Please fix the lookup so an empty mapping is honoured.
